scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && for dir in services/*; do npm install --prefix $dir; done
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix services/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/user-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/product-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/order-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/payment-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/notification-service"
